'''Pharen's sister''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked at the [[Silent Sun cantina]] in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun territory|territory]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] she provided a clue about the [[Noetikon]]s to [[Pharen]], an assistant to [[Attros Finn]].
